title: Lift and settle a two-kilogram payload
prompt: Edit robot.xml so the named lift_servo raises the 2 kg payload through the payload_slide joint when commanded to 0.30 m. The protected grader executes 1,500 MuJoCo steps under gravity. Success requires the payload_site to finish at least 0.20 m above its initial height, with absolute final slide velocity no greater than 0.02 m/s and peak absolute actuator force no greater than 50 N. Preserve the payload, payload_slide, payload_site, and lift_servo names; keep the site and slide on the payload body and the servo connected to that slide. The grader measures the executed trajectory; declarations or stored success flags do not count.
